vb_textbox.text: Each time you select a gnome, remember which one you picked and then whether it was good at finding mushrooms or not. I said in my head 'long brown, short purple, etc. There are 4 gnomes in total. 2 generally offer no or very few muchrooms, whilst the other 2 will give lots. The good gnomes and bad gnomes switch around in terms of mushroom output about every 5 rounds. I was tending to switch to a different gnome when it dropped to about 2 or 3 mushrooms. One thing that caught me off guard was that sometimes I switched gnomes and then those ones weren't any good either, then I went back to the other gnomes again and they were good again. So sometimes the mushroom count goes down for a bit for all the gnomes and then it gets better again with the same ones. I think it's pretty random whether it switches or not, as it seemed about 50/50. Overall, trust your instinct. :)
